title: Kan Gemma 4 Good Demo Package
subtitle: Android-first breach response demo, video, evidence, and submission files
description: Kan is a local-first Android assistant for Guatemalan citizens responding to personal-data leaks. This dataset contains the demo ZIP, final narrated video, writeup, evidence, and reproducibility files for the Gemma 4 Good Hackathon submission. It uses synthetic data only and includes no API keys.

resources.description: Downloadable demo package with APK, static demo page, final video, evidence, screenshots, and Unsloth scaffold.
